simple.meaning: בּוּשָׁה (bûwshâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “shame.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בּוּשָׁה (H955) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 89:46, with occurrences in Psalms, Ezekiel, Obadiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בּוּשָׁה (H955) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בּוּשָׁה (H955) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בּוּשָׁה (bûwshâh) / H955 is traced through Psalms 89:46, Ezekiel 7:18, Obadiah 1:10, Micah 7:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
Then my enemy will see it,
